FROM

        BULK 'https://sahyivy.blob.core.windows.net/ods/ods_order_info',
         FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS [result]

    consignee_tel          VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,

    order_status           VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    user_id                VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    payment_way            VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    delivery_address       VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    order_comment          VARCHAR(200) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    out_trade_no           VARCHAR(50) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    trade_body             VARCHAR(200) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    create_time            VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    operate_time           VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    expire_time            VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    process_status         VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    tracking_no            VARCHAR(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    parent_order_id        VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    img_url                VARCHAR(200) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    province_id            VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    activity_reduce_amount VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    coupon_reduce_amount   VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    original_total_amount  VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    feight_fee             VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    feight_fee_reduce      VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    refundable_time        VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
) AS rows;



CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ods_order_info (
    id                     BIGINT,
    consignee              VARCHAR(100),
    consignee_tel          VARCHAR(20),
    total_amount           DECIMAL(10,2),
    order_status           VARCHAR(20),
    user_id                BIGINT,
    payment_way            VARCHAR(20),
    delivery_address       VARCHAR(1000),
    order_comment          VARCHAR(200),
    out_trade_no           VARCHAR(50),
    trade_body             VARCHAR(200),
    create_time            DATETIME2,
    operate_time           DATETIME2,
    expire_time            DATETIME2,
    process_status         VARCHAR(20),
    tracking_no            VARCHAR(100),
    parent_order_id        BIGINT,
    img_url                VARCHAR(200),
    province_id            INT,
    activity_reduce_amount DECIMAL(16,2),
    coupon_reduce_amount   DECIMAL(16,2),
    original_total_amount  DECIMAL(16,2),
    feight_fee             DECIMAL(16,2),
    feight_fee_reduce      DECIMAL(16,2),
    refundable_time        DATETIME2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_order_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = ods_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

--手动创建完整外部表
-- 1、创建数据库范围凭据
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL WorkspaceIdentity
WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';

-- 2、创建外部数据源（基于已链接的存储账户）

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ods_external_source
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'abfss://ods@sahyivy.dfs.core.windows.net/',
    CREDENTIAL = WorkspaceIdentity
);

-- 3、创建外部文件格式
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
    DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'
);

-- 4、创建外部表

    id                     BIGINT,
    consignee              VARCHAR(100) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,

    delivery_address       VARCHAR(1000) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    order_comment          VARCHAR(200) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    out_trade_no           VARCHAR(50) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    trade_body             VARCHAR(200) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    create_time            DATETIME2,
    operate_time           DATETIME2,
    expire_time            DATETIME2,
    process_status         VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    tracking_no            VARCHAR(100) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    parent_order_id        BIGINT,
    img_url                VARCHAR(200) COLLATE Chinese_PRC_CI_AS,
    province_id            INT,
    activity_reduce_amount DECIMAL(16,2),

    feight_fee             DECIMAL(16,2),

WITH (
    LOCATION = 'ods_order_info',
